title: Fourier expansion of affine subspace density
statement: Let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ and $a\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. As a function of $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the uniform probability density of the affine subspace $a+H$ is $\sum_{\gamma\in H^\perp}(-1)^{\langle\gamma,x+a\rangle}$, where $H^\perp$ denotes its orthogonal complement for the standard dot product over $\mathbb{F}_2$.
